items.title: Ermax lists Lusin Residences in Dubai International City
items.summary: Off-plan studios to 2-bedroom apartments and penthouses (467–2,634 sq ft), handover Q4 2027, on sale with three published payment plans.

items.title: New World launches Marwa Views in Meydan
items.summary: Off-plan studios to 3-bedroom apartments (457–1,809 sq ft), handover Q1 2027, on sale with a 20/40/40 payment plan.

items.title: Object One lists 1CTRL in Dubai Land
items.summary: Off-plan 1 to 3-bedroom partly furnished apartments (567–2,051 sq ft), handover Q2 2029, on sale with two published payment plans.

items.title: Ardee unveils Ardee Views towers in Al Marjan Island
items.summary: Twin residential towers totalling 652 units, the residential gateway to the AED 15bn+ Ardee Downtown mixed-use district; phased delivery from 2030.
